subject.title: feat: let plugins enforce outbound delivery policy

question: Should the new public `outbound_delivery_policy` hook be a fail-closed enforcement boundary when a registered handler times out or errors, or a best-effort transformation hook that may still send the original payload?
rationale: This choice determines whether plugins can safely implement the read-only and strict-policy use cases cited by the PR, and it becomes a long-lived public plugin SDK contract rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed enforcement
options.body: When any registered outbound-policy handler cannot complete, suppress the affected delivery and expose a typed audit outcome; this matches the stated enforcement use case.

options.title: Keep best-effort semantics
options.body: Continue delivery after policy-handler timeout or error, but narrow the API name and documentation so operators cannot mistake it for an enforceable outbound boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed enforcement
recommendation.body: When any registered outbound-policy handler cannot complete, suppress the affected delivery and expose a typed audit outcome; this matches the stated enforcement use case.
